results.title: Kubiak: Raiders will decide when to start Mendoza based on his play and not the offense as a whole
results.description: The Las Vegas Raiders face challenges with an unproven offensive line and no standout wide receiver. Coach Klint Kubiak said decisions on Mendoza’s starting role will depend on his development, not the surrounding offense. Rookie Mike Washington Jr. might start as running back due to Ashton Jeanty's injury. Fernando Mendoza, drafted first overall, is likely the backup quarterback to Kirk Cousins when the season opens Sept. 13 against Miami. The Raiders' offense was the worst in the NFL last season.
